name: ExampleBloodPressureControl
title: Example: blood pressure under control
description: An illustrative measure, not a CMS eCQM: adults 18 to 85 with hypertension whose blood pressure readings in the period were all below 140/90, with at least one reading.

criteria.expression: %subject.birthDate <= (%periodEnd - 18 years) and %subject.birthDate > (%periodEnd - 86 years) and entry.resource.ofType(Condition).where(code.coding.where((system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' and code = '38341003') or (system = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-cm' and code = 'I10')).exists() and (clinicalStatus.empty() or clinicalStatus.coding.code = 'active')).exists()

entry.resource.ofType(Observation).where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '85354-9').exists() and effective.ofType(dateTime) >= %periodStart and effective.ofType(dateTime) <= %periodEnd).select(component.where(code.coding.code = '8480-6').value.ofType(Quantity).value < 140 and component.where(code.coding.code = '8462-4').value.ofType(Quantity).value < 90).allTrue() and entry.resource.ofType(Observation).where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '85354-9').exists() and effective.ofType(dateTime) >= %periodStart and effective.ofType(dateTime) <= %periodEnd).exists()
